Administration & Human Resources
View administrative and human resource related information.
Assessor
Learn the duties of an assessor as well as how the assessor records and values your property for tax purposes in Isanti County.
Attorney
Browse the duties of the Isanti County Attorney office as well as contact information to report a crime in the area and services provided to victims of crimes.
Auditor-Treasurer
View information regarding property tax, finance, elections, passports, issuing of an identification card, and other services.
Boards & Commissions
Access meeting times, member lists, and agendas and minutes for the boards and commissions that serve Isanti County.
Community Corrections
The Community Corrections Mission Statement is to hold juvenile and adult offenders accountable by providing research based supervision, referral to appropriate rehabilitative services and facilitating restorative justice practices designed to prevent future delinquent and criminal behavior in an effort to increase public safety.
County Commissioners
See details and contact information of the county commissioners.
County Surveyor
Contact the County Surveyor
Court Administration
View the Isanti County District Court website where you can find information on programs and services, locating records, and other administrative documentation.
Emergency Management
Read about the emergency management system and the Everbridge communication system; as well as view helpful links.
Facilities Management
Learn about the tasks and duties of the Facilties Management department and find contact information for the office.
Geographic Information Systems
The Isanti County GIS department is responsible for the development and maintenance of Isanti County GIS applications.
Health & Human Services
The Isanti County Family Services Department administers an array of services established by local, state, and federal law that promotes the protection, support, and rehabilitation of families and individuals.
Highway
The County Highway Department administers construction and maintenance activities on County highways and issues permits for ingress/egress, over width/overweight loads, and utilities.
Information Technology
Isanti County's Information Technology Department is responsible for coordinating and administering the operations of the County's computer systems and telephone system.
Law Library
The Library consists of WESTLAW online legal research as well as printed publications.
Parks & Recreation
The mission of Isanti County Parks Recreation is to maintain, acquire and/or expand parks that preserve natural areas, provide passive recreation opportunities, strive to maintain the rural character of the county and promote the health, well-being and quality of life for residents of the county.
Public Drainage
Isanti County has 24 public drainage systems. These can be broken down into 19 County Ditches and 5 Judicial Ditches (ditches that cross county lines), totaling 142 miles of open ditch
Recorder
The Recorder's Office is responsible for filing and recording all documents pertaining to real estate, liens against personal property, military discharges, notary commissions, and state and federal tax liens. Maintains birth, death, and marriage records.
Sheriff
Our mission is to serve with honor, integrity and pride, to treat each person with respect and dignity and perform our duties in a professional, efficient and impartial manner for the citizens of Isanti County.
Transit
Find information about the Transit Department, including route hours.
University of Minnesota Extension
The University of Minnesota Extension provides practical education and research you can trust to help people, businesses and communities solve problems, develop skills, and build a better future.
Veterans Services
The Isanti County Veterans Service Office provides assistance to veterans, their dependents, or survivors in all programs of veterans affairs available at federal, state, and local levels, including Veterans Administration and the Minnesota Department of Veterans Affairs.
Zoning
The Zoning Department interprets, enforces, and provides consultation on county zoning, shore land, flood plain, wetlands, subdivision and platting, recycling, household hazardous waste program, and county solid waste ordinances.
